ABOUT / THE PREMISE

EVERYTHING INFLUENCES EVERYTHING.

ORBIT is an immersive digital archive exploring connections between eight creative disciplines:

Fashion · Architecture · Cinema · Photography
Art · Typography · Product Design · Graphic Design

Through first-person exploration, visitors discover how ideas, techniques and visual languages travel between disciplines.

THE PLAN

The archive is laid out like Filarete’s Sforzinda, the ideal city of the Italian Renaissance: an eight-pointed star made of two squares turned against each other, a central piazza, and streets running out to every point. Here each point is a discipline, and each line between two points is a story about how one shaped the other.

New: Via. In Sforzinda every street ends in the central piazza. In ORBIT, pick where you start and where you want to go: Via walks you along the stories that connect them, names what each street carried, and drops you in the piazza with a brief to make something.
